label: A possible first-moment beginning is a possible finite-duration beginning (inference)
rule: In linear time the first moment's clock reading bounds the past below (MetricGrimReaper.metricallyFiniteOfBegun)
meaning: Strength order between the two senses of B1 (linear time, any real clock): a possible populated history in which the time before every populated moment has a first moment is one in which that time is of finite duration, because in linear time a past with a first moment has finite duration. The converse fails: MetricBeginningArrival control 2 (positive real times) satisfies B1 in sense BEGINS_2 and not in sense BEGINS_1. This is the only passage between the senses; it runs from BEGINS_1 to BEGINS_2. No premise is established.
